powers.name: Cube of Force
powers.text: Once per dawn, the trident acts as a Cube of Force's fifth face.

sentience.purpose: to spread the worship of the sea god

summary: +3 trident of the sea: water breathing, a swim speed, and Critical Hits that drain half the target's vitality.
text: This trident, kept in the depths of White Plume Mountain, is a gorgeous weapon etched with waves, seashells and sea creatures. It grants +3 to attack and damage rolls, and a Critical Hit with it deals bonus Necrotic damage amounting to half the target's Hit Point maximum. It doubles as a Weapon of Warning and a Trident of Fish Command. In your hand it lets you breathe underwater and swim at a speed of 60 feet, grants what a Cap of Water Breathing would, and works as a Cube of Force, with you choosing the effect rather than pressing a face. It is sentient (Charisma 18, Intelligence 14, Wisdom 10) and serves a god of the sea.
